page1.text:
"Mm..."
Morning.
Slowly, my mind wakes up, and I sluggishly sit up.

page2.text:
The clock reads after 8 o'clock.
I'm late.
Okay, I'm not exactly "late" since I'm not going to school, but I definitely overslept.

page3.text:
"Oh no, I need to make breakfast."
I get up and change.
While changing from my pajamas to my regular clothes, I'm forced to look at my left arm whether I like it or not.

page4.text:
"...Hup."
I try lifting my left arm during my morning stretches.
No problem here.
I can lift it up to shoulder level, exactly as I intend.
It's improving day by day.
I still can't feel anything through it, but at this rate, by tomorrow it should—

page5.text:
"What are you doing, Shirou? Breakfast is already over."
"Huh? Wuh? Wait, what?"

page6.text:
Illya's in front of me.
I meant to go to the living room, but I somehow ended up in the shed.

page7.text:
"Did you hear me, Shirou? I asked you what you're doing here."
"Y...yeah, I heard you. Morning, Illya. Funny running into you here."

page8.text:
...Hm.
My answer sounds absurd even to me.
I must not be fully awake yet.

page9.text:
"Shirou. Are you not feeling well?"
"Eh? No, I'm fine. I'm just still a little sleepy. Hold on."
I shake my head.
I'm still physically exhausted, but the drowsiness is gone.

page10.text:
"...There. To answer your question, I'm not here for any particular reason. I just took a wrong turn while I was half-asleep."
"Okay. Well, come to the living room. I'll make you breakfast."
Illya cheerfully runs back into the yard.

page11.text:
It's a clear day.
The sky is a bright blue, washing away yesterday's gloom.
I take a deep breath, filling my lungs with comfortably cool air.

page12.text:
"...Hm? Did Illya say she's making breakfast?"
She did.
The first thought that comes to my now-operational mind is her last remark.

page13.text:
Illya's breakfast... I'm looking forward to it, but the notion makes me very uneasy.
I can say with confidence that Illya has never been in a kitchen before, much less picked up a chef's knife.

page14.text:
"Ahh... I should probably go supervise her."
I head towards the living room, feeling the prickly grass beneath my feet.
I'm shocked again.
Talk about sleepwalking!
What was I thinking, coming out here barefoot?

page15.text:
I arrive in the living room almost four minutes later,
after taking the time to clean the dirt off my feet.
"Oh, Senpai."
I nearly bump into Sakura when I enter the living room.

page16.text:
"Morning, Sakura... Sorry about this morning. I overslept until after eight."
...
...?
Sakura stares at me. I wonder if she didn't hear me.

page17.text:
"Sakura?"
I reach out to her, thinking her fever might have come back.
But...
"G-good morning, Senpai!"
She greets me at full volume, making my concern unwarranted.

page18.text:
"Hey, you're in good spirits this morning. Does that mean your body's feeling better?"
"Y-yes, thanks to you, I'm full of energy. B-because you gave me some of yours."

page19.text:
"Hm?"
Sakura speaks haltingly.
...Hmm. I'm glad she's upbeat, but the fact she doesn't look calm makes me worried, too.

page20.text:
"What's wrong? Sakura? You're being kinda weird. What do you mean, I gave you some of my energy?"
"Ah, uh... I mean, er, last night..."
"In your bedroom," she trails off.
Sakura mumbles bashfully.

page21.text:
"...Oh."
Now I remember.
How could I forget?
Last night,
I held Sakura.

page23.text:
"Agh... Oof."
Heat suddenly rises to my head.
It instantly reaches boiling point, as if all of my blood below my neck was pumped there.

page24.text:
"S-Sakura, last night, that..."
Really happened, right? It wasn't a dream?
Blushing and with an expression that seems to blame me somehow, she nods.

page25.text:
"~~~~~~~~~"
Wow.
Just when I thought my face couldn't get any hotter, it does.
Meaning that last night...

page26.text:
Shirou Emiya's rational mind labeled everything that happened
as a dream, and filed it away—wait, not that!

page27.text:
"Sakura, um. S-sorry about that."
I clumsily apologize to her, holding my dizzy head in my hand.
"...Yes, but I was happy, Senpai."
Her shy smile is like a mortal blow to the heart.

page28.text:
"Ah...urgh."
...She got me.
She's so lovely. I want to hug her again right now.

page29.text:
If Illya wasn't around and I didn't hear the TV on in the living room, I'd…
"Shirou! Breakfast is ready!"
If Illya hadn't chimed in right on cue, I might have charged straight into super-mushy mode again.

page30.text:
"A-anyway, I'm here to eat breakfast. Let's talk later!"
I make a sharp turn like a robot and head for the living room.
I desperately move my sluggish arms and legs, taking control of my mind and driving the desire into a corner of it.
